question: What proteins are synthesized in the ribosomes attached to the endoplasmic reticulum ?:

options.opb: The proteins of the mitochondrial matrix.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: mRNA with a signal sequence -> binds to a ribosome on the endoplasmic reticulum -> protein synthesis occurs -> secretion proteins are synthesized -> 85% confidence. CHAIN: Signal recognition particle (SRP) recognizes the signal sequence -> guides the ribosome to the endoplasmic reticulum -> protein synthesis occurs -> secretion proteins are synthesized -> 85%
enhanced_information: Proteins synthesized in the ribosomes attached to the endoplasmic reticulum include secretion proteins. This process involves mRNA with a signal sequence binding to a ribosome on the endoplasmic reticulum, where protein synthesis occurs. The Signal Recognition Particle (SRP) plays a role in guiding the ribosome to the endoplasmic reticulum for the synthesis of these proteins. Evidence supports the interaction of SRP with the endoplasmic reticulum, reinforcing the connection between protein synthesis and secretion proteins.
analysis: Proteins synthesized in the ribosomes attached to the endoplasmic reticulum include secretion proteins.
